$comment: Single source of truth for the editor's font registry. Add a font by dropping its .ttf in public/fonts/ and appending an entry here — no code change. `defaults` lists the ids loaded at boot (keep this minimal: one Latin + one dual-script Arabic for a fast interactive boot); every other font lazy-loads (JIT) the first time it is picked. The seed / fallback-root face is the first Latin entry of `defaults_by_script` (`defaults[0]` when there is none). URLs are relative to the document base, so they survive a deploy under a subpath. As of issue #23 the engine's FontFamily is string-backed, so ANY id registered here renders when applied — the engine resolves the loaded face by id (no hardcoded allowlist). `cairo` is the worked example of a JIT, non-default custom font. Issue #472: `defaults_by_script` declares, per script, which loaded face shapes text that names no font family (or one nothing resolves), in preference order (`latin`, `arabic`; each value is an ordered id list, a bare id string also works). The boot sequence sends it to the engine as `SET_FONT_PRIORITY` (text_pipeline::FontStack::with_priority), so the default no longer depends on how face ids sort — Amiri also covers Latin and sorts first, which used to give the interactive editor Amiri glyphs and tall line metrics for Latin text. `tools/harness-fonts` declares the same table (a unit test pins the agreement); the Latin entry is also the seed/fallback-root face (so script-neutral text and scripts the stack does not specialise take it too). Issue #329: `substitutes` lists the faces the engine's font-substitution table (text_pipeline::SUBSTITUTIONS) maps document families to — Carlito for Calibri, Caladea for Cambria, Liberation Serif / Mono for Times New Roman / Courier New, Gelasio for Georgia, Selawik for Segoe UI, Noto Naskh Arabic for Simplified Arabic and for Arabic text in Arial / Times New Roman. The boot sequence loads them next to `defaults` so an opened document lays out in metric-compatible faces; their SIL OFL licences ship under fonts/licenses/.
